interpretation_guardrail: Tier is review priority, not truth. Exploratory components remain visible because independent recovery can miss valid near-erased ink; no tier is automatically owned or merged.

observations: On held-out thank-you-for, 3,676 strong plus 1,512 likely pixels account for 86.96% of the 5,966 vector proposal; only 778 pixels remain exploratory.
On acknowledgement-tight, strong and likely tiers account for 4,953/6,349 pixels and visually concentrate on the target writing continuation.

On near-erased enough-tight, 6,409/7,502 pixels remain exploratory because independent recovery also missed the word. The exploratory tier visibly contains much of the valid word, so it must remain reviewable rather than being discarded.
The tiers are interaction priority and training provenance, not truth labels: green first, orange second, magenta only on incomplete words, with every accept/reject preserved.

selection_rule: Apply the same 10% whole-component support rule to all five frozen vector crops; use 1px-dilated independent local recovery evidence.

tier_definitions.likely-balanced-supported: not strong; overlap with 1px-dilated balanced recovery >=10%
tier_definitions.strong-conservative-supported: vector component overlap with 1px-dilated conservative recovery >=10%
